jobs.why: r1 (flux-2, one board image): the throw drawn grey-beige with long fringe, not the pecan muslin; the set too large

prompt: Studio product photograph of a cushion set exactly as sold, made of the four products shown in the reference images (the first image is a 2 x 2 board of all four; the next four images show each one alone, in the same order), each reproduced faithfully in colour, weave, texture and proportion: (1, top-left in the board) a 50 x 50 cm square cushion in oatmeal light grey-beige boucle with a nubby curled surface; (2, top-right) a 50 x 50 cm square cushion in camel wide-stripe corduroy with deep raised vertical ribs; (3, bottom-left) a 30 x 50 cm rectangular lumbar cushion in plain beige linen-look woven fabric; (4, bottom-right) a 150 x 200 cm throw in pecan, a warm reddish brown, crinkled multi-layer cotton muslin with a small waffle grid and short frayed fringe on all edges, exactly the colour of the reference. Composition: the throw is folded neatly into a flat soft rectangle lying on the floor of the backdrop, its short frayed fringe visible along the front edge; the two square cushions stand upright side by side on the folded throw, slightly overlapping, plump, with soft corners; the lumbar cushion stands in front of them, lower. Shot on a seamless warm off-white paper backdrop that sweeps from wall to floor in one even very light warm off-white tone (about #F0E7DB, neither yellow nor grey), no horizon line, no texture. One large soft key light from the upper left with gentle fill; a soft, gentle contact shadow under the product, falling slightly to the lower right. Camera: a three-quarter view from the front-left, the lens about 30 degrees above the floor plane looking down at the product at an angle, not a top-down flat lay, so the front edge, the thickness and the sides of the product and the backdrop sweep behind it are visible; the set centred and filling about 70 percent of the square frame, the whole set in frame with clear empty backdrop margins on all sides. Premium interior catalogue product photograph, photorealistic, crisp true-to-life textile texture, accurate colours, neutral white balance. No props, no plants, no furniture, no people, no text, no logos.
references: the card SKU photos (supplier URLs) or boards/crops of them uploaded to var2; the supplier pixels stay out of the output
